en.title: GTA 6's Official Album Announced, Pre-Orders Now Live for Vinyl and CD
en.summary: Rockstar Games has officially unveiled the soundtrack for the highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI, with pre-orders now available. Fans can secure their copies of the album on CD or vinyl, with multiple editions to choose from.
en.body:
The world of **Grand Theft Auto VI** is expanding beyond Vice City's neon-drenched streets with the official announcement of **GTA 6: The Album**. Rockstar Games, in partnership with Atlantic Records, has opened pre-orders for the game's official soundtrack, giving fans a new way to connect with the upcoming title.

Available for pre-purchase on CD and vinyl, the album offers a tangible piece of the **GTA 6** experience. For vinyl enthusiasts, there are two options: a standard edition and a limited edition, promising unique collector's items. Digital versions are also ready for pre-save on major music streaming platforms like Spotify and Apple Music, ensuring the soundtrack will be easily accessible on launch day. While specific track names haven't been fully detailed in the initial announcements, the reveal of an official album signals a significant investment in the audio landscape of **Grand Theft Auto VI**, suggesting a soundtrack that will be as integral to the game as its groundbreaking visuals and gameplay.

## A Soundtrack for Vice City
The announcement of the album arrives as pre-orders for **Grand Theft Auto VI** itself are gearing up. Set to launch on November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, the game will be available at a standard price of $79.99, with an Ultimate Edition priced at $99.99. This pricing structure, confirmed by Take-Two Interactive, places **GTA 6** at the higher end of current gaming releases. A notable detail for physical copies is the inclusion of a download code instead of a traditional disc, a modern approach that may streamline the installation process for players. The game promises the biggest, most immersive evolution of the **Grand Theft Auto** series yet, set in a vibrant, tropical urban environment.

## What This Means for Fans
The release of an official album is more than just a merchandise opportunity; it's a testament to the cultural significance of the **Grand Theft Auto** franchise. For years, the soundtracks of **GTA** games have been iconic, shaping the atmosphere and defining eras within the game world. The decision to formalize and promote an official album suggests Rockstar is leaning into this legacy, potentially offering a curated collection that captures the essence of **GTA 6**'s setting and narrative. Fans are already buzzing about the possibilities, speculating about the artists involved and the musical styles that will define this new chapter in the beloved series. The pre-order bonuses, including a Vintage Vice City Pack and **GTA+** benefits for digital pre-orders, further incentivize early adoption.
